statement.description: Allen has a LOT of money. He has $ n $ dollars in the bank. For security reasons, he wants to withdraw it in cash (we will not disclose the reasons here). The denominations for dollar bills are $ 1 $ , $ 5 $ , $ 10 $ , $ 20 $ , $ 100 $ . What is the minimum number of bills Allen could receive after withdrawing his entire balance?
statement.formatI: The first and only line of input contains a single integer $ n $ ( $ 1 \le n \le 10^9 $ ).
statement.formatO: Output the minimum number of bills that Allen could receive.
statement.hint:
In the first sample case, Allen can withdraw this with a $ 100 $ dollar bill, a $ 20 $ dollar bill, and a $ 5 $ dollar bill. There is no way for Allen to receive $ 125 $ dollars in one or two bills.

In the second sample case, Allen can withdraw two $ 20 $ dollar bills and three $ 1 $ dollar bills.

In the third sample case, Allen can withdraw $ 100000000 $ (ten million!) $ 100 $ dollar bills.

translation.description: Allen 有很多钱。他在银行里有 $n$ 美元。出于安全原因，他想把这些钱全部取现（具体原因我们在这里不予透露）。美元纸币的面额有 $1$、$5$、$10$、$20$、$100$。Allen 最少能收到多少张纸币？
translation.formatI: 输入的第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$1 \le n \le 10^9$）。
translation.formatO: 输出 Allen 最少能收到的纸币数量。
translation.hint:
在第一个样例中，Allen 可以用一张 $100$ 美元纸币、一张 $20$ 美元纸币和一张 $5$ 美元纸币取出这笔钱。Allen 不可能用一张或两张纸币取出 $125$ 美元。

在第二个样例中，Allen 可以用两张 $20$ 美元纸币和三张 $1$ 美元纸币取出这笔钱。

在第三个样例中，Allen 可以用 $100000000$（一亿！）张 $100$ 美元纸币取出这笔钱。

由 ChatGPT 4.1 翻译
